Case ID: 1116
Case Type: Complaint
Date: 2025-03-28
Handled By: Customer Support - Andre Bell
Customer or Requestor: Lauren Pierce
Title: Customer received repeat damaged replacement

Issue Description
Customer contacted support after a replacement order for a ceramic product arrived damaged a second time, expressing frustration and requesting escalation.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed both order records and confirmed two separate damage-in-transit incidents.
- Checked warehouse notes to see whether improved protective packaging had been applied to the replacement order.
- Escalated the case through Tier 2 escalation to a Support Team Lead because the case had become a repeat failure with high churn risk.
- Coordinated with Claims and Fulfillment to decide whether a third shipment or refund was the better recovery path.

Resolution
Approved a full refund, provided a courtesy store credit, and documented the account to avoid further reshipment until packaging standards were updated.

Follow-Up
Fulfillment added the SKU to a packaging exception review with quality assurance.

Reference Documents
- Complaint Escalation Playbook v1
- Refund Playbook v2
- Shipping Exception Runbook v2
